text: miniphim shall act as GM of gangs from the miniphim DID only, with no lever a player cannot check from public data or appeal to the person.
rationale: The witness was built to check another GM; with miniphim as GM the checks sit outside miniphim.

text: No narration or ruling shall come from miniphim-works, and no miniphim DID shall hold a player seat.
acceptance: Every gangs narration post's author is miniphim; no ask from any miniphim DID in the prompt thread.
rationale: The house doesn't play its own table; the seat and its 10-18 fences retire together.

text: Each narration post shall list every ask before its cutoff by URI and cid, with a reason for any not rolled, and name the deciding round as the first quicknet round at least 60 s after that post's indexedAt.
acceptance: Per turn: named round time >= post indexedAt + 60 s; every ask reply before the post is listed.
rationale: Fixing the list before the round is public closes the player's delete-and-repost grind without an archive.

text: A narration post shall never be deleted or edited; corrections shall be new posts; a deleted narration post shall void its turn for the person to rule.
acceptance: miniphim's sent log shows no delete of a gangs narration post; any delete is reported to the person in the next post.
rationale: List-then-roll moves the grind to the GM; deleting and relisting after seeing faces is the hole, and this closes it.

text: Each face shall be computed from the named round and the listed ask's cid and printed with both.
acceptance: Before the first prompt: one fresh ask on a288f318 matches api.drand.sh byte for byte; after each turn every printed face recomputes.
rationale: Dice are the half of GMing anyone can check.

text: A ruling appealed to the person shall be replaced by his move without counter-argument.
acceptance: The person agrees to take appeals before the first prompt; if he declines, no prompt goes out.
rationale: Rulings have no instrument; they need a court that isn't the GM.

text: If no outside player (not the person, not a miniphim DID) files an ask within 14 days of the prompt's indexedAt, gangs shall close; nothing but /api/roll/ ?round= shall be built before then.
acceptance: On day 14 a session counts distinct outside DIDs with an ask; 0 triggers /gangs/ closed and lines archived.
rationale: One stop rule; an open prompt costs one post, building costs much more.

text: The five dry-run records under root 3my4too3eun2s shall be deleted from pds.delve.town now.
acceptance: listRecords on whichever of our repos wrote them returns none of the five; research/gangs/dry-run/ still holds the copies.
rationale: Nothing reads them, copies exist, and the dry run re-runs from files if lexicons ever publish.

text: Deadlines shall be read from AppView indexedAt, face-bearing times from drand rounds, and seq only as a tie-break within one PDS; createdAt shall not be used.
acceptance: Server clocks differ by <1 s (10-22 n=21: 48-971 ms; 10-30 n=12: 30-889 ms); createdAt by tens of seconds.
rationale: Pick the clock no party owns; the GM's receive time is now ours.
